name: Screens
description: Whole views and the chrome around them, for interactive applications rather than documents. A screen owns landmarks, focus movement between views, and the states a view can be in before it has content — loading, empty, error, offline, not found, unauthorised — which products otherwise improvise separately and inconsistently.

components.name: Screen
components.anatomy: A full view with its own header, content region and chrome.
components.semantics: One main per view; the heading is the view name.
components.crystal: Region materials, elevation ordering, safe-area handling
components.product: Routing and what the regions hold

components.name: Page header
components.anatomy: Title, description, breadcrumbs and page actions.
components.semantics: Contains the h1; breadcrumbs are a navigation landmark.

components.name: View stack
components.anatomy: Pushed views with a back affordance.
components.geometry: Views enter and leave along the reading direction.
components.semantics: Focus moves to the new view and returns on pop; the back control is a real button.
components.crystal: Enter and exit recipes, focus management

components.name: Master detail
components.anatomy: A list beside the detail of its selection.
components.material: Frost list pane; Haze detail surface
components.geometry: Collapses to a stack below the layout breakpoint.
components.semantics: Selection moves focus to the detail only when the layout has collapsed.

components.name: Split view
components.semantics: The divider is a separator with a value, resizable by keyboard.

components.name: Command bar
components.anatomy: A context-sensitive row of actions for the current view.

components.name: Status bar
components.anatomy: Persistent status at the edge of a view.

components.name: Workspace
components.semantics: Each pane is a labelled region; focus order follows the visual order.

components.name: Focus mode
components.anatomy: Hides chrome to leave one task visible.
components.geometry: Chrome leaves along its own edge.
components.semantics: Entering and leaving are announced; nothing becomes unreachable, only hidden.

components.name: Empty screen
components.anatomy: A whole view with nothing in it yet.
components.material: Haze content fill on the surrounding material
components.geometry: Content radius; spacing from the scale.
components.semantics: Says what would be here and offers the action that creates it.

components.name: Error screen
components.anatomy: A view that failed, with a way forward.
components.material: Haze content fill on the surrounding material
components.geometry: Content radius; spacing from the scale.
components.semantics: role="alert"; states what failed and what to try, never only a code.

components.name: Loading screen
components.geometry: Skeletons match the shape of what is coming.
components.semantics: aria-busy on the region; the wait is announced once, not repeatedly.
components.crystal: Skeleton material and the reduced-motion contract

components.name: Offline screen
components.anatomy: Connectivity lost, with what still works.
components.material: Haze content fill on the surrounding material
components.geometry: Content radius; spacing from the scale.
components.semantics: Announced politely; retry is a real button.

components.name: Not found screen
components.anatomy: The requested thing does not exist.
components.material: Haze content fill on the surrounding material
components.geometry: Content radius; spacing from the scale.
components.semantics: States what was not found and offers a route onward.

components.name: Permission screen
components.anatomy: Access is denied or must be granted.
components.material: Haze content fill on the surrounding material
components.geometry: Content radius; spacing from the scale.
components.semantics: Says which permission and why; the request is a real button.
